title: Function coverage for Write Single Register
purpose: Provide a valid function 0x06 request with a simple address and 16-bit value pair.
expected_behavior: Server should parse the request as Write Single Register for address 0x0001 with value 0x0001 and either echo a normal write response or return an exception.
constraints_preserved: length is 0x0006 for unit_id plus 5-byte function 0x06 PDU.
Function code 0x06 is used for Write Single Register.
Address and register value are encoded as big-endian 16-bit fields.
issue_safety_notes: The seed uses a conservative address and value and avoids malformed or stress-oriented content.
